'''Diness Imler''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She resided in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. She sometimes did favors for [[Officer/Legends|officers]] in the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]].
